The agent declared "TASK_COMPLETE" after incorrectly identifying Option D as the correct equation without fully balancing all options. Specifically, Option D (H2 + O2 -> H2O) is not balanced as written because it would need to be 2 H2 + O2 -> 2 H2O to demonstrate conservation of mass, indicating a premature decision based on superficial analysis. This shows an oversight in verifying the accurate balance of atoms across all provided options, in alignment with Example 1 where the Planner failed to cross-check detailed atom counts on both sides of the equations.
